messages:
ara: Quick sync: Prospect 'Halcyon' has pushed back on latency during microbursts. They want a documented POC showing sustained 600 qps p95 < 50ms and handling of 1000 qps for 30s. Also need pricing and security Qs answered. Can eng scope a plan?

tom: Yes. Proposed baseline: redwood-m-8k quantized on dedicated nodes. Need 4xA100 to start. How are they measuring qps (concurrent users vs requests per second)?

ara: They measure per-request qps. Typical message sizes: prompt ~40-60 tokens, response ~100-140 tokens. They also use a fixed bot prefix that can be cached.

jess: Proposed quick load/test plan:
```
# Halcyon POC plan
prework: provision 4xA100 cluster, NVMe-backed cache; ensure KMS configured
soak: 2h @ 350 qps to warm caches
main: 3 runs of: ramp 0->600qps (3m), sustain 10m @600qps, inject 30s burst @ 1k qps mid-run
post: 30m cooldown, collect traces
metrics: p50/p90/p95/p99, success rate, batch size distribution, tokens emitted, GPU util
notes: run with batching window 10ms, tune to 12ms during bursts; enable prefix KV caching; fallback route to smaller model on sustained >1s overload
```

infra-bot: provision-bot: cluster halcyon-poc-2026 created (4xA100). bench image v2 pushed.

jess: Security asks: KMS-backed keys, TLS, SOC2 docs, log redaction. We'll include an optional private control plane.

tom: Early smoke (5m) shows: sustained 600 qps -> p95 45ms, p50 15ms. Burst 1k qps -> p99 200-250ms with a few 502s. Tuning: increase batch window to 12ms during burst windows and increase KV TTL from 30s->60s.

ara: Next steps:
- apply tuning and run 3 full runs (tom/jess) - ETA: tomorrow morning
- prepare perf dashboards + brief writeup (tom) - ETA: after runs
- security questionnaire draft (jess) - ETA: EOD today
- pricing sensitivity (ara + finance) - ETA: 48h

ara: Also flag: halcyon asked if we support bringing own HSM. That's an edge-case (2-3 week lead). Include as note.

infra-bot: scheduled-bench: halcyon-2026-03-22-09 queued.
